semantics.Y1: Next y[1]: A transitions to B only when w=0
semantics.Y3: Next y[3]: B,C,E,F transition to D only when w=1
semantics.reset: State machine resets to A, but this interface has no reset or state storage; y is supplied externally. At y=A,w=0 outputs are 1,0; at y=A,w=1 outputs are 0,0.
semantics.timing: No clock, latency or initialized storage specified; outputs respond combinationally to y,w.

numeric.widths: 6-bit one-hot state; single-bit input and outputs
numeric.invalid_states: No recovery specified; use inspected one-hot Boolean equations without validity gating.

verification.oracle: Original transition list independently mapped to destination state indices, then project bits 1 and 3.
verification.coverage: All six legal states with both w values, zero and multi-hot extension via union of per-state transitions, directed unknown-input propagation
verification.sampling: Drive inputs then wait one time unit for combinational settling
verification.success: Fatal on mismatches; bounded timeout and PASS after all checks

specification_ambiguities.issue: Corrupted prose names Y2 and Y4 while interface lists Y1 and Y3.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Preserve declared Y1/Y3 ports and compute explicitly requested next y[1]/y[3].

specification_ambiguities.issue: Behavior for non-one-hot states is not separately defined.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Implement Boolean equations by inspection; additional development cases test this equation extension, not an asserted FSM recovery requirement.
